records.name: ARTPARK heat-risk forecasting (Karnataka)
records.provider: ARTPARK (IISc), with KSNDMC, KSDMA and the Karnataka Department of Health
records.summary: Sub-district heat-risk predictions up to seven days ahead, built with Government of Karnataka bodies. No public view of the forecasts was found.
inputs: Not documented on the provider's page.
outputs: Heat-risk predictions at sub-district level, up to seven days ahead (as described).
records.method_summary: Provider description only; method, inputs and validation are not published on the page.
limitations: A forecast horizon is not evidence of accuracy; no validation is published on the page.
Public access, users and operational status were not found.
Do not treat as an official warning: warnings stay with IMD and KSNDMC.

evidence.classification_basis: Provider description plus editorial categorisation; not independent certification.

follow_up_checks: Find a public product page or government use record.

records.name: DEFT: Ecosystem-based Adaptation Feasibility Tool (Bengaluru)
records.provider: CSTEP, supported by IUCN (Global EbA Fund)
records.summary: A GIS-based decision-support tool in development to judge where ecosystem-based measures could reduce heatwave and flood risk in Bengaluru, extending to Bangalore Urban District.
inputs: Not yet public; the project describes hydrology, land use, biodiversity and socio-economic data, a household survey and an ecological survey.
outputs: Feasibility of ecosystem-based measures; flood and heatwave risk maps; a blue-green infrastructure map (intended).

geography.spatial_scale: Bengaluru and Bangalore Urban District; described as hyper-local, resolution not stated

records.method_summary: Provider description of a tool in development; intended outputs are not yet released.
limitations: In development: no live tool address was found.
Intended outputs are not completed outputs.

evidence.classification_basis: Provider description plus editorial categorisation; not independent certification.

follow_up_checks: Check for a public release of the tool.
Record its resolution and licence once published.

records.name: Heat Safety Charter for Apartment Workers (Bengaluru)
records.provider: HeatWatch Foundation and the Bangalore Apartment Federation, with support from the Bangalore Sustainability Forum
records.summary: Practical heat safety measures an apartment community can adopt in extreme heat for domestic and housekeeping staff, security guards, gardeners, delivery workers and drivers, in English, Kannada and Hindi.

geography.spatial_scale: Written for apartment complexes in Bengaluru

records.method_summary: A charter developed by a worker-focused organisation and an apartment federation; not an evaluated intervention.
limitations: No reuse licence is stated: free to read is not permission to republish.

evidence.classification_basis: Provider description plus editorial categorisation; not independent certification.

follow_up_checks: Check whether adoption is being tracked.
Check the Kannada and Hindi versions with a speaker.
